programme.desc: Gym Neighbours: Doug and Carrie start working out with Lou (aka The Incredible Hulk) and Carla Ferrigno (guest starring as themselves).

programme.desc: Moon Dance: When Niles decides that it's time to start dating again, he takes Daphne to a posh society ball. But has she got the wrong idea about his intentions?
